parameters.url: ={{ $env.SUPABASE_URL }}/rest/v1/story_state_snapshots?select=episode_id,season_id,snapshot_data&project_id=eq.{{ $('Input Normalizer & Scope Resolver').first().json.project_id }}&episode_id=lt.{{ $('Input Normalizer & Scope Resolver').first().json.episode_no }}&order=episode_id.desc&limit=1

parameters.jsCode:
const ctx = $input.item.json;
const hs = ctx.hydrated_sources;

const compiledContinuityContext = [
  `=== EVALUATION MODE: ${ctx.evaluation_mode} | PROJECT: ${ctx.project_name} | SEASON ${ctx.season_no}, EPISODE ${ctx.episode_no} ===`,
  `=== SOURCE 1: MASTER STORY BIBLE ===`,
  JSON.stringify(hs.story_bible || {}),
  `=== SOURCE 2: CANON FACTS ===`,
  (hs.canon_facts || []).length > 0 ? hs.canon_facts.map(f => `[${f.canon_status}] (${f.fact_type || 'GENERAL'}) ${f.fact_key}: ${JSON.stringify(f.fact_value)}`).join('\n') : 'No explicit canon_facts rows.',
  `=== SOURCE 3: LATEST COMMITTED STORY STATE SNAPSHOT ===`,
  hs.latest_snapshot ? JSON.stringify(hs.latest_snapshot) : 'No previous episode snapshot (Episode 1 start).',
  `=== SOURCE 4: CHARACTER STATUS ===`,
  (hs.character_status || []).length > 0 ? hs.character_status.map(cs => `- ${cs.character_code}: status=${cs.status} (changed_ep=${cs.status_changed_ep})`).join('\n') : 'All characters assumed alive.',
  `=== SOURCE 5: RECENT STORY TIMELINE ===`,
  (hs.story_timeline || []).length > 0 ? hs.story_timeline.map(t => `- Ep ${t.episode_no} (${t.event_code || ''}): ${t.event_description} @ ${t.location || 'N/A'} (Participants: ${JSON.stringify(t.characters_involved || [])})`).join('\n') : 'No prior timeline events.',
  `=== SOURCE 6: STORY RULES ===`,
  (hs.story_rules || []).length > 0 ? hs.story_rules.map(r => `- [Priority ${r.priority || 1}] ${r.rule_code}: ${r.rule_text}`).join('\n') : 'Standard anime universe physics apply.',
  `=== SOURCE 7: MYSTERY TRACKER ===`,
  (hs.mystery_tracker || []).length > 0 ? hs.mystery_tracker.map(m => `- [${m.status}] ${m.mystery_id}: ${m.description} | Clues: ${JSON.stringify(m.clues || [])}`).join('\n') : 'No active open mysteries.',
  `=== DETERMINISTIC PRE-CHECK FLAGS ALREADY DETECTED ===`,
  JSON.stringify(ctx.deterministic_violations || []),
  `=== TARGET CONTENT TO VALIDATE ===`,
  `User Prompt: ${ctx.user_prompt}`,
  ctx.script_text ? `Script Text:\n${ctx.script_text}` : '',
  ctx.scenes && ctx.scenes.length > 0 ? `Scenes JSON:\n${JSON.stringify(ctx.scenes)}` : ''
].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');

return { json: { ...ctx, compiled_continuity_context: compiledContinuityContext } };
